subject: How to use the input of previous tabPanels of Navbar?

messages.author: e7371377f3747f7d
messages.subject: How to use the input of previous tabPanels of Navbar?
parts:
Hello,

I am working on a shiny App, that has a Navbar with three tabPanels. The first and second ones are to allow users to upload the file and write to some places. 
I am trying to get the third one with the input of the previously two ones. While, the problem is I can not identify the dataName in ui.R for the third tabPanel. {(error: object 'data' not found), yes, since it's not there from very beginning)

The App was supposed to run like: User upload file in Tab1, then upload file in Tab2. The Tab3 will select the list from both of them by helpers.R and display it.

Attached is the ui for the third tabPanel.

 tabPanel("DataSet Seclection",

                            if (is.null('file2')){                                                          #file2 is the input of Tab2
                              return(NULL)
                              }else{
                                fluidRow(
                                  div(class="span4",
                                      
                                      selectInput("Ven", "Choose a Vendor:", 
                                                  c("ALL",unique(as.character(data$Vendor))))                   #for data$Vendor, I am not sure which name should be given to the unknown dataset, that was supposed to be generated from Tab1 and Tab2 
                                  ),
                                  div(class="span4",
                                      selectInput("Client", "Choose a Carrier:",
                                                  c("ALL",unique(as.character(data$Carrier))))                    #same as above, data$Carrier, how to call the data that haven't been created....
                                      
                                  ),
                                  fluidRow(
                                    dataTableOutput(outputId="table")),
                                  
                                  downloadButton('downloadData2', 'Confirm')
                                  
                              )}

Would someone happen to know that?


Thanks!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to use the input of previous tabPanels of Navbar?
parts:
The UI you specify in ui.R is rendered completely when the app loads. So anything that's data-dependent like this has to come from the server. You have two options:

1) Have these selectInputs start out with empty vectors for their choices. Then in your server.R, assuming you have a reactive(...) called "data", set up observers like this:
observe({
  if (!is.null(data()))
    updateSelectInput(session, "Client", choices = data()$Carrier)
})
Do this once for each dynamic select input.

2) Take out the interior of this tabPanel and replace it with a uiOutput("tab3"), and on the server side, have output$tab3 <- renderOutput({...}) that dynamically generates this UI. See http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/dynamic-ui.html
